Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zuarrow 0.0.0.9000

  • Initial CRAN submission.

Handles and schema tools

  • arrow_schema() makes a schema handle from an Arrow format string, from an R object, or from any schema, array or stream handle, and format() and print() show Arrow’s type notation.
  • Handles share the ‘nanoarrow’ package’s layout and inherit from its classes, so handles cross between the two packages without conversion.
  • arrow_validate() runs the bundled ‘nanoarrow’ C library’s validation at "minimal", "default" or "full"; "full" also checks that every string is valid UTF-8.
  • arrow_equal() compares two schemas, arrays or streams, and says why they differ.
  • arrow_metadata() and arrow_metadata<- read and write schema metadata, keeping binary values as raw vectors.
  • zuarrow_info() reports the versions zuarrow is built from.
  • Every condition inherits from zuarrow_error.
